name: sView
description:
sView is an open-source media player specialized in viewing 3D stereoscopic videos, photos, and panoramic media. Supporting a wide range of 3D display hardware, it renders immersive content with high precision.

Features:
- Comprehensive 3D stereoscopic output modes including Anaglyph, Side-by-Side, and Interlaced
- Hardware support for 3D TVs, shutter glasses, VR headsets, and polarized displays
- Panoramic 360-degree and 180-degree spherical photo and video playback
- Hardware-accelerated video decoding with multi-channel spatial audio support
- Intuitive on-screen controls for adjusting parallax, stereo separation, and color balance
